text: Two follow-ups to job 86p4, from running 'athena backtest' on the real records (condition (a) now passes; (b) fails). First, the D87 intervention signal still matches class 'docs'; docs/design/decision-sets.md section 9 revised it to class 'code', so fix the code to match. Second, the 405 that falsified D87 (PR #41, job 9h2j) happened before host errors were recorded; it exists only in intervention 20261013-192156-ar1x, whose text says GitHub refused a merge commit with HTTP 405. Add a way to derive host-error records from past interventions whose text states a host refusal: the derived record is marked derived, cites its source intervention, and is never presented as having been observed by the client. Derivation is a typed decision that may later use Jev, but here use a strict exact pattern in code ('HTTP <code>' plus a merge operation). Rerunning the backtest should then flag D87 under review, citing ar1x through the derived record, and flag nothing else. Report the real result either way.
